massing_review.findings: 29×59 elongated envelope, cross-front roof, rear raised hall, small pier-side box and offset carousel agree in broad proportions. detail_review.results: Eight arch composition, four shopfront divisions, red frames/brick piers, scalloped parapet and distinct low/high roof volumes retained. Lettering widths enlarged after first render to match characteristic broad sign. Street camera reduced to eye height to avoid orthographic overexposure of rear roofs.
remaining_estimates: Font is a locally available serif/italic approximation, not a traced exact commercial logo. Small bulb spacing is sampled rather than surveyed.
Rear roof shallow falls represented by level roof plates; underside and screened service contents deferred.
Pier-side detail based on older close coverage; current advertising omitted.
Carousel is an intentionally plain pavilion placeholder, not detailed ride.
detail_review.surface_ownership: All source meshes audited, including mouldings/frames, lettering and both parts. Repeated arch endpoint lamp duplication removed; compact triangle lamp faces avoid quad triangulation residue. Sign widths checked not to overlap.
